lines.text: Solomon married Pharaoh's daughter, brought her to the City of David, and loved the LORD, but sacrificed on high places.
Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings at Gibeon, and there the LORD appeared to him in a dream.
Solomon said he was only a little shepherd and asked God for an understanding heart to judge the people.
God was pleased and promised Solomon a brave heart, riches, honor, and, if he walked in His ways, long life.
Solomon awoke, returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark, offered sacrifices, and held a feast for his servants.
